We search for a Philosopher’s Stone to cheat our grief, believing power can undo our mistakes. But true alchemy isn't turning lead into gold—it is having the courage to surrender your magic, tear down your pride, and stand before the Truth as nothing more than a fragile, ordinary human who chooses to love.
